longmemeval_v2.reason: Official evaluation needs multimodal web-agent trajectories/screenshots; the local checkout contains question and evidence-step metadata only.

limitations: LoCoMo, MemBench, and BEAM tracks measure evidence retrieval rather than answer generation.
MemoryAgentBench evidence is derived from accepted answers appearing in context chunks.
LongMemEval-V2 is inventory-only until multimodal trajectory data is available.
Published system scores are not directly comparable unless model, judge, corpus, and budget match.
